plan.concept: 2D Rotation transformation of a shape around the origin with its matrix representation in homogeneous coordinates.
plan.layout: Vertical stack: rotated square on 2D axes at the top, 'Rotation' label in the middle, and homogeneous matrix equation at the bottom.

series.label: Rotated Square
series.note: A square centered at (0,0) rotated counter-clockwise by 15 degrees

panels.nodeDecorations: The square has a solid dark gray outline (#333333) and a vibrant green fill (#4be318)
annotations: Red curved arrow starting from x-axis to the red dashed line representing angle theta
Text label 'Rotation' centered below the plot, above the matrix formula

plan.colorScheme: White background, black axes, green shape fill (#4be318) with dark gray border (#333333), and red highlights (#ff0000) for the angle indicator.
plan.reconstructionNotes: To faithfully reconstruct this, place the 2D coordinate canvas in the upper half. Draw the rotated green square with vertex coordinates matching a 15-degree rotation. Draw a dashed line from the origin extending at 15 degrees. Draw a red arc with an arrowhead starting on the positive x-axis and ending on the dashed line, with a 'theta' label. Below this, render the serif text 'Rotation' and the homogeneous matrix equation: [x'; y'; 1] = [cos(theta) -sin(theta) 0; sin(theta) cos(theta) 0; 0 0 1] * [x; y; 1] using LaTeX or clean SVG paths.
